title: Design System: GDGC ISSATSO Recruitment Platform

title.purpose: Page headings only — one per page.

label.purpose: Uppercase pane/card headers; the console's wayfinding lettering.

body.purpose: All reading text: question text, answers, table cells.

score.purpose: The live weighted total — the only display-size number; tabular-nums mandatory.

shadows.name: rail
shadows.purpose: shadow-sm — persistent rails (queue, note card) only; never used to fake depth.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The system's 'currently here' glow on every focusable control.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Micro-feedback: hovers, badge swaps, colour changes.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Default for entrances, exits, state changes; score-button receipt beat.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Hard ceiling; reserved for larger travel (mobile drawer, progress bar).

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Sibling stagger step; ~7 widgets finish under 0.35s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Blue fill, 32px, 10px radius; the operator's main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #4285f4; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(66 133 244 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: #4285f4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(66 133 244 / 0.5); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Red tint fill, never solid — destructive reads as a warning, not a wall.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(234 67 53 / 0.1); color: #ea4335; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgb(234 67 53 / 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: rgb(234 67 53 / 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(234 67 53 / 0.2); outline: none; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: 20px status pill; tint carries the meaning, not a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4285f4; color: #ffffff; font: 500 12px/1 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-destructive { background: rgb(234 67 53 / 0.1); color: #ea4335; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { border-color: #4285f4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(66 133 244 / 0.5); outline: none; }

components.name: Input
components.description: 32px hairline field; focus shifts border + 3px ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #171717; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #4285f4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(66 133 244 / 0.5); outline: none; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; background: rgb(236 236 236 / 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface: hairline border, no resting shadow.
components.html:
Note

Anything to flag for the ranking stage.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: #171717; padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-card-label { display: block; font: 600 11px/1 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }

components.name: Score Button Group
components.description: One button per noteScale value; selection is instant-write with a 200ms scale receipt.
components.css: .ds-scoregroup { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-score { min-width: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); font: 600 14px/1 'Geist Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-score:hover { border-color: #4285f4; color: #4285f4; } .ds-score-selected { border-color: #4285f4; background: #4285f4; color: #ffffff; } .ds-score:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(66 133 244 / 0.5); outline: none; }

narrative.overview: This is an instrument panel, not a billboard. The people using it score applicants one by one, dozens of times per hour, on laptops — so every surface is built for repeated contact: compact 32px controls, a strict color vocabulary that means exactly one thing per hue, and motion quick enough to read as feedback rather than theatricality (0.3s is a hard ceiling). Color is the console's language: signal blue speaks with the platform's voice, and green/red/yellow are status ink — never decoration. The neutrality is deliberate and OKLCH-based: flat tonal surfaces with hairline dividers carry all structure, letting the four status inks stay loud because nothing around them competes.
keyCharacteristics: One palette, aliased everywhere — brand blue, three status inks, no second red, no decorative color
Flat-by-default surfaces with hairline borders; elevation only as a response to intent
Compact, consistent 32px control height across buttons, inputs, and selects
Motion capped at 0.3s with instant reduced-motion fallbacks that never leave content hidden
Dark-first friendliness: every surface token has a tuned .dark override

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Each status hue says one thing app-wide: green = accepted/complete, red = rejected/destructive, yellow = pending, blue = primary action. A color never picks up a second meaning within a status role.

rules.name: The No Second Palette Rule
rules.body: Never restate a hex. New tokens alias the canonical ones, and no component hardcodes a hex — every color resolves through globals.css.

rules.name: The Dark-Night Rule
rules.body: Every color token ships a .dark override tuned by hand; nothing is left to browser default blending.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates in place renders with tabular-nums, so digits never twitch as values change.

dos: Do reference tokens (bg-primary, text-status-rejected, border-border) — never hardcode a hex.
Do import all motion from motion-tokens.ts and collapse every animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do use the Icon wrapper (lucide-react) exclusively.
Do reserve status ink for its one meaning and pull destructive confirmations through the shared ConfirmDialog.
Do keep controls at the compact scale (32px control height, 14px body).
donts: Don't introduce marketing-site gloss — no gradients, no glassy blur, no oversized type, no motion slower than 0.3s.
Don't restyle a primitive into a one-off; extend the cva variants or the shared component instead.
Don't let a color acquire a second meaning within status roles.
Don't invent a second icon system or an unlabeled icon-only control without an accessible name.
Don't cache or persist computed values in the UI when they are live-derived on read.
